sources.traces: 98d07986: .claude/window1_live_v4_replay/v52b_read_level_authority_20260812/V52B_FULL_DECISION_TRACE_30_GAMES.jsonl.gz - 613,394 receipts / 30 games; frequencies below are live, not theory
sources.rule: no invented structure: every node is a question the code actually asks; code values with zero trace appearances are flagged observed_0

nodes.question: Is this market awake yet?
nodes.technical: stability onset, clause 1 (window1_v52_stability_onset.js; license.onset; binding CODEX-INTERIM, PRIMED standard supersedes in a future iteration)

refers_to.plain: the gap between best bid and best ask, minute by minute over the whole window
the two legs' mid-prices summed, distance from 100
contracts sold in the trailing hour

classifies_into.candidate_A: spread collapsed AND pair mid-sum settled (both two-segment splits fall) -> A_SPREAD_COLLAPSE_PLUS_CROSS_LEG_MIDSUM_SETTLE; else rejected SPREAD_AND_MIDSUM_DID_NOT_BOTH_SETTLE
classifies_into.candidate_B: sales arrived in sustained cadence (split rises) -> B_SUSTAINED_TRADE_CADENCE_ARRIVAL; else rejected TRADE_CADENCE_DID_NOT_INCREASE
classifies_into.selected: earliest valid candidate; per receipt: passed / not-yet (onset.passed true/false)

nodes.question: What do I believe this side is doing?
nodes.technical: machine read (incumbent S1/S2/S3 classifier chain, 300s trail; license.read)

refers_to.plain: new highs of the best bid and new lows of the best ask in the trailing window
contracts sold by an aggressive buyer or seller
top-5 depth balance between the two sides of the book

classifies_into.no_reading_possible: NO_DIRECTIONAL_QUOTE_OR_PRINT_EVIDENCE -> read.passed=false (158,965 rows, 25.9% - the read-starvation lens)

nodes.produces: read.passed + state + the directional-evidence receipt and timestamp
consumed_by: N4 (the evidence that earns the level)

nodes.question: What price does the diary remember?
nodes.technical: post-onset true-trade diary, clause 3 reference (license.diary; V52b role RECORDED_REFERENCE_INPUT_NOT_SOLE_LEVEL_AUTHORITY)

refers_to.plain: the cheapest contract sold on this side since the market woke
the cheapest contract sold on the other side since it woke

classifies_into.passed: a post-onset sale exists on this side (277,172 rows) / none yet (336,222)

nodes.produces: the two remembered lows (reference only under V52b; was the sole level source under V52)

nodes.question: Where should my bid stand?
nodes.technical: level authority (V52b machineReadLevel - iteration 1's read-level authority)

refers_to.plain: the level the old reflex machine proposes right now, and which organ proposed it
the cheapest and dearest prices observed since the market woke
refers_to.source: live book + sold record since onset

refers_to.plain: the read's evidence: which receipt, when, both post-onset
the sanity rail: never at or above the ask, never above the pair cap

four_checks: supported_authority (proposal from join or tracking organ)

fired_in_traces.observed_0_note: the two level-side block reasons MACHINE_READ_LEVEL_AUTHORITY_NOT_EARNED and NO_LAWFUL_MACHINE_READ_POST_LEVEL never surfaced as the named block in 30 games - an earlier clause always failed first (order-masking)

nodes.question: Do my two readings agree, and is the pair under par?

refers_to.plain: the two remembered lows summed against 100
the disagreement flag between the quote-path reading and the pressure reading
refers_to.source: the sibling's / own classifier state (S3 flag)

refers_to.plain: whether the other side is already bought

nodes.degenerate: SCREW #3, marked honestly: when the readings disagree the only answer is freeze - a blanket HOLD. The flag fires on 262,345 rows (median 680 per game) yet is the NAMED block only 5,384 times because earlier clauses usually fail first; adjudicate-not-freeze is queued.

nodes.question: May this bid exist right now?
nodes.technical: the license verdict (firstFailure, fixed first-failure order: onset -> read -> pair-under-par -> disagreement -> level-authority -> lawful-level)

refers_to.plain: the five clauses' outputs, in fixed order

observed_0: V52-only diary blocks POST_ONSET_TRUE_TRADE_LOW_ABSENT / NO_LAWFUL_DIARY_POST_LEVEL (superseded path)

fired_in_traces.note: first-failure ordering masks later clauses - frequencies are of the NAMED block, not of clause truth

nodes.question: What do I do with the standing bid?

conservation.every_trace_value_mapped: gate_verdict/blocked_clause/reason -> N6+N7; final_action -> N7; incumbent_action/reason -> N8; onset.* -> N1; read.* -> N2; diary.* -> N3; coherence.* -> N5; level.*+machine_read_evidence -> N4; scavenger -> N8. No trace value is unmapped; named gaps: none.
